headings.strategy: Expressive, technical, and large. Use tracking-tighter for high impact. Used for H1-H4.

body.strategy: Highly readable, sterile, corporate mono-hybrid. Establishes trust and technical precision.

labels.strategy: Uppercase, tiny font size (text-xs to text-sm), extremely wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]). Used for overlines, buttons, tickers, and data labels.

colors.strategy: Dark Neon + Corporate Clean. Base is near-pitch black (Obsidian) for an executive cyberpunk vibe. The sole bright accent is Electric Cyan to highlight interactive elements and vital metrics.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #1E2028 for structural elements. 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for glass/overlay elements. Never use thick, blocky borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on borders and high contrast instead of soft drop shadows. For glowing/active states, use drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)].
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism exclusively for the sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70). Solid dark surfaces for bento cards.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition explicitly (e.g., transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease). Primary buttons should invert to bg-[#00E5FF] and text-[#050505] on hover.

grids.bento_services: Tetris Mode (Asymmetrical): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create tension. Do not make equal squares. This creates an editorial, high-end tech feel rather than a cheap template.

layouts.hero: Min 90vh height. Left-aligned or deeply offset content. Needs a kinetic masked typography reveal (line-by-line).
layouts.marquee: An 'Editorial Ribbon' ticker separating the hero and services. Slow-moving, monospaced text (JetBrains Mono) with tech specs or core pillars.
layouts.services: Bento grid wrapped in a container with luxurious padding (py-32).
layouts.about: Asymmetrical 2-column layout. High contrast text offset from the image block to create negative space/breathing room.
layouts.contact: Clean, tight layout for form fields indicating corporate reliability. Shadcn/UI inputs customized for the dark theme.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use lenis (@studio-freight/react-lenis) for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer motion line-by-line masked text reveal. Text lines wrapped in overflow-hidden with child variants mapping { initial: { y: '100%' }, animate: { y: 0 } }.
motion.parallax: Framer motion useScroll and useTransform for translating background images on the Y-axis.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on dark bg meets APCA/WCAG. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via CSS media queries or Framer Motion hooks.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for QA.

image_urls.description: Abstract blue cyber lines, to be placed behind a heavy black overlay (bg-[#050505]/80) for the hero section parallax.
Server rack with blue lighting. Use in the IT Consulting / Infrastructure bento card with an overlay.
Software code screen. Use in the Custom Software Development bento card.
Business professionals meeting. Use in the Sobre nosotros (About) section. Best applied with a grayscale filter and cyan hover effect to match theme.

libraries.notes: Use Shadcn components for complex interactive logic (forms, inputs, textareas, toasts). Combine them with the styling rules above.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS extensively. Import the specified Google Fonts in your root CSS file and map them in tailwind.config.js.

For the SWIFT TASK logo, design a custom SVG wordmark directly in the React code. Use a blocky/tech font style with an electric cyan accent (e.g., a glowing square node replacing the dot on the 'i' or at the end of the text).
Build the functional Contact Form (Contacto) using Shadcn Form/Input/Textarea. Simulate backend save with a setTimeout and trigger a success Toast using Sonner.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are added to the form submit button (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button') and all navigation links.
Strictly follow the Dark Neon + Corporate Clean theme. No white backgrounds allowed except for text and highly specific accents.
Do NOT center-align the main app container. Let the text align naturally (left) to support the B2B aesthetic.
Include the Marquee between the Hero and Services, with tech terminology like '[ ENCRYPTION: ACTIVE ] /// [ INFRASTRUCTURE: SCALABLE ] /// [ ZERO TRUST ]'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the exact provided image URLs in the media section.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, explicit active states, and focus-visible rings.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
